turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. At night, alone in a closed superstore, he lies on top of a tall shelf next to a bowling ball and an apple resting on a plank that sticks out over the aisle. He is about to drop them both at once to see which lands first: gleeful, mad-scientist excitement, a giggly whisper on the first two words that builds to a triumphant shout on the last.
turns.text: Heavy... <short pause> light... <short pause> for SCIENCE!
